## Appearance

Nell possesses a slight, small, and slender frame, standing an inch taller than [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), with a straight-backed figure and a slender, alabaster neck. Her sharp, bright, and ethereal face features a small pointed chin, a pleasant, freckled nose bearing seven freckles, and cheeks that display a soft rose hue. She is distinguished by her large, radiant, and earnest gray eyes alongside her prominent hair, which is styled in long red or crimson braids, though it is also described variously as ginger, auburn, [Titian](../character/titian.md), or green. When unplaited, her bright, fiery hair flows out like a radiant river.

## Personality

An unusual and unselfish individual, she is notably intelligent yet prone to being overly careless, hasty, and impetuous. She possesses a vivid imagination, theatrical phrasing, and a talkative nature, often drifting into reveries while performing chores. Her character combines a resolute and stubborn will with an optimistic outlook, although her high expectations can lead to deep disappointment. While she harbors strong animosities and a swift temper, her capacity for affection is equally intense, marked by a love for children, people, nature, and the color pink. She demonstrates talent in writing essays, poetry, and stories, running swiftly, baking cakes, and working well with youngsters, despite initially lacking general cooking skills. Driven by strong personal ambitions, she seeks to become a teacher, excel in her examinations, bring beauty to the world, spark modest happiness in others, and learn how to best assist herself and those around her.

## History

An orphan girl, Nell Harcourt was taken from an asylum by [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and brought to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) by [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) [F1, F4, F15, S1]. Though initially facing return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), she earned a place at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and formed a lifelong friendship with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) [S2, S3, S5, S10]. Early mishaps included accidentally serving currant wine to Isolde, which led to a brief strain with the [Pembrokes](../character/pembroke.md) before Nell personally reconciled with the family after treating Isolde's sick sister [S17, S18, S19, S20]. She also won over strict [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) and adapted to local social life despite childhood blunders, such as temporarily dyeing her red hair green [S22, S33]. Showing great academic promise under her teacher Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), Nell tied for first place on the island in her entrance examinations [S38, S41]. Following the sudden death of [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), she selflessly gave up a college scholarship to stay home and care for the failing vision of [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), taking a local teaching post that her former rival [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) stepped aside to let her have [S47, S48, S49]. As Brierley's schoolteacher, she led community efforts for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and helped care for the orphaned Farrow twins when [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) took them in [S54, S55, S57, S58]. She successfully managed her classroom, mediated local misunderstandings, and eventually arranged for widowed [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so she could prepare to attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) [S63, S81, S84, S86]. During this transition, a walk with Hugh awakened her realization of deeper feelings between them [S88].

## Quotes

> "If you were a parentless child who arrived at a spot expected to be your home, only to discover you were undesired for not being a male, you would weep as well. Oh, my life has never known a more calamitous event!"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "yet, oh, I beg you to address me as Lucinda. What name you use for me cannot be of great importance to you if my stay is to be merely brief, can it? Besides, Nell is a name so lacking in romance."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why failed you to inform me at the depot that I was unwanted and abandon me at that place? Had I not observed the Petal Road of Delight and the Lake of Glassy Waters, this would be less difficult."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She acquired Lily Jones for her own. Lily has reached just five years of age and is extremely beautiful, possessing nut-brown hair. Were I extremely beautiful with nut-brown hair, would you retain me?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "In what way is it possible for you to term the night good, given your awareness that it has to be the most terrible one I have ever experienced?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P49](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

The relationship began with intense friction when Mrs. Sowerby visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and insulted Nell's appearance, driving Nell into a furious outburst. However, after Nell delivered a humble apology, Mrs. Sowerby forgave her and offered encouraging words. Mrs. Sowerby later offered advice on managing Nell's temper, commended her physical growth, and ultimately complimented her grace and character.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. ### [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-lavinia--nell-harcourt.md)

After a late-night prank led to an awkward encounter, Nell smoothed over the situation by taking full responsibility and apologizing directly to [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md). Impressed by her honesty and charm, [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) forgave the girls and formed a warm, lasting friendship with Nell. She later hosted Nell at her home in [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) for events like the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and concert.

### [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--pettifer.md)

Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) and Nell are neighboring acquaintances whose relationship shifted from conflict to amicable friendship.
